verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software agent or AI tool, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agentic or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
